paragraphs.kana: 콩쥐는 원님과 결혼해서 오래오래 행복하게 살았어요.
paragraphs.roman: Kongjwineun wonnimgwa gyeolhonhaeseo oraeorae haengbokhage sarasseoyo.

q.fr: Pourquoi la sandale ne va-t-elle pas à Patjwi ?
q.en: Why doesn’t the slipper fit Patjwi?
How does the story end for Kongjwi?

summary.fr: À Namwon, la fidèle Chunhyang tient tête à un préfet cruel en attendant son bien-aimé, parti passer le grand concours.
summary.en: In Namwon, faithful Chunhyang stands up to a cruel prefect while waiting for her beloved, who has gone to sit the great state examination.

paragraphs.jp: 조선 시대 남원에 춘향이라는 아름다운 처녀가 살았어요.
paragraphs.fr: À l’époque Joseon vivait à Namwon une belle jeune fille nommée Chunhyang.
paragraphs.en: In the Joseon era, a beautiful young woman named Chunhyang lived in Namwon.
paragraphs.kana: 조선 시대 남원에 춘향이라는 아름다운 처녀가 살았어요.
paragraphs.roman: Joseon sidae namwone chunhyangiraneun areumdaun cheonyeoga sarasseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 단옷날, 춘향은 광한루 근처에서 그네를 타고 있었어요.
paragraphs.fr: Le jour de la fête de Dano, Chunhyang se balançait près du pavillon Gwanghallu.
paragraphs.en: On the day of the Dano festival, Chunhyang was riding a swing near the Gwanghallu pavilion.
paragraphs.kana: 단옷날, 춘향은 광한루 근처에서 그네를 타고 있었어요.
paragraphs.roman: Danonnal, chunhyangeun gwanghallu geuncheoeseo geunereul tago isseosseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 마침 그곳에 놀러 온 원님의 아들 이몽룡이 춘향을 보자마자 첫눈에 반했어요.
paragraphs.fr: Lee Mongryong, le fils du magistrat, venu s’y promener, tomba amoureux d’elle au premier regard.
paragraphs.en: Lee Mongryong, the magistrate’s son, who had come there for an outing, fell for her at first sight.
paragraphs.kana: 마침 그곳에 놀러 온 원님의 아들 이몽룡이 춘향을 보자마자 첫눈에 반했어요.
paragraphs.roman: Machim geugose nolleo on wonnimui adeul imongryongi chunhyangeul bojamaja cheonnune banhaesseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 몽룡은 하인 방자에게 춘향을 데려오라고 했어요.
paragraphs.fr: Mongryong ordonna à son serviteur Bangja d’aller chercher Chunhyang.
paragraphs.en: Mongryong told his servant Bangja to bring Chunhyang to him.
paragraphs.kana: 몽룡은 하인 방자에게 춘향을 데려오라고 했어요.
paragraphs.roman: Mongryongeun hain bangjaege chunhyangeul deryeoorago haesseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 두 사람은 이야기를 나누면서 서로 사랑하게 되었고, 몰래 혼인을 약속했어요.
paragraphs.fr: En parlant, ils tombèrent amoureux l’un de l’autre et se promirent secrètement le mariage.
paragraphs.en: As they talked, they came to love each other and secretly promised to marry.
paragraphs.kana: 두 사람은 이야기를 나누면서 서로 사랑하게 되었고, 몰래 혼인을 약속했어요.
paragraphs.roman: Du sarameun iyagireul nanumyeonseo seoro saranghage doeeotgo, mollae honineul yaksokhaesseoyo.

words.fr: jour de la fête de Dano

words.en: to fall in love at first sight

q.fr: Où Mongryong voit-il Chunhyang pour la première fois ?
q.en: Where does Mongryong first see Chunhyang?

choices.fr: Près du pavillon Gwanghallu, sur une balançoire
choices.en: Near the Gwanghallu pavilion, on a swing

q.en: What do they promise each other?

paragraphs.jp: 그런데 얼마 후 몽룡의 아버지가 한양으로 가게 되었어요.
paragraphs.fr: Mais peu après, le père de Mongryong fut appelé à Hanyang.
paragraphs.en: But soon afterwards, Mongryong’s father was posted to Hanyang.
paragraphs.kana: 그런데 얼마 후 몽룡의 아버지가 한양으로 가게 되었어요.
paragraphs.roman: Geureonde eolma hu mongryongui abeojiga hanyangeuro gage doeeosseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 몽룡도 아버지를 따라 떠나야 했어요.
paragraphs.fr: Mongryong dut suivre son père.
paragraphs.en: Mongryong had to leave with his father.
paragraphs.kana: 몽룡도 아버지를 따라 떠나야 했어요.
paragraphs.roman: Mongryongdo abeojireul ttara tteonaya haesseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 「과거 시험에 합격하면 꼭 너를 데리러 올게.」
paragraphs.fr: « Quand j’aurai réussi le grand concours, je reviendrai te chercher, c’est promis. »
paragraphs.en: “When I pass the state examination, I will come back for you, I promise.”
paragraphs.kana: 「과거 시험에 합격하면 꼭 너를 데리러 올게.」
paragraphs.roman: “Gwageo siheome hapgyeokhamyeon kkok neoreul derireo olge.”

paragraphs.jp: 춘향은 눈물을 흘리면서 몽룡에게 거울을 주었고, 몽룡은 춘향에게 옥가락지를 주었어요.
paragraphs.fr: En larmes, Chunhyang donna un miroir à Mongryong, et lui offrit à Chunhyang une bague de jade.
paragraphs.en: In tears, Chunhyang gave Mongryong a mirror, and he gave her a jade ring.
paragraphs.kana: 춘향은 눈물을 흘리면서 몽룡에게 거울을 주었고, 몽룡은 춘향에게 옥가락지를 주었어요.
paragraphs.roman: Chunhyangeun nunmureul heullimyeonseo mongryongege geoureul jueotgo, mongryongeun chunhyangege okgarakjireul jueosseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 그 후로 춘향은 매일 몽룡을 기다렸어요.
paragraphs.fr: Dès lors, Chunhyang attendit Mongryong chaque jour.
paragraphs.en: From then on, Chunhyang waited for Mongryong every day.
paragraphs.kana: 그 후로 춘향은 매일 몽룡을 기다렸어요.
paragraphs.roman: Geu huro chunhyangeun maeil mongryongeul gidaryeosseoyo.

q.en: Why does Mongryong leave?

choices.fr: Son père est envoyé à Hanyang
choices.en: His father is sent to Hanyang

q.en: What does Chunhyang receive as a keepsake?

paragraphs.jp: 새로 온 원님 변학도는 욕심이 많고 나쁜 사람이었어요.
paragraphs.fr: Le nouveau magistrat, Byeon Hakdo, était un homme cupide et mauvais.
paragraphs.en: The new magistrate, Byeon Hakdo, was a greedy, wicked man.
paragraphs.kana: 새로 온 원님 변학도는 욕심이 많고 나쁜 사람이었어요.
paragraphs.roman: Saero on wonnim byeonhakdoneun yoksimi manko nappeun saramieosseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 변학도는 춘향이 아름답다는 소문을 듣고 자기의 사람이 되라고 했어요.
paragraphs.fr: Ayant entendu dire que Chunhyang était belle, Byeon Hakdo lui ordonna de devenir sienne.
paragraphs.en: Having heard that Chunhyang was beautiful, Byeon Hakdo ordered her to become his.
paragraphs.kana: 변학도는 춘향이 아름답다는 소문을 듣고 자기의 사람이 되라고 했어요.
paragraphs.roman: Byeonhakdoneun chunhyangi areumdapdaneun somuneul deutgo jagiui sarami doerago haesseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 하지만 춘향은 「저는 이미 혼인을 약속한 사람이 있습니다.」라고 대답했어요.
paragraphs.fr: Mais Chunhyang répondit : « Je suis déjà promise à quelqu’un. »
paragraphs.en: But Chunhyang answered: “I am already promised to someone.”
paragraphs.kana: 하지만 춘향은 「저는 이미 혼인을 약속한 사람이 있습니다.」라고 대답했어요.
paragraphs.roman: Hajiman chunhyangeun “Jeoneun imi honineul yaksokhan sarami itseumnida.”rago daedaphaesseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 화가 난 변학도는 춘향을 감옥에 가두었어요.
paragraphs.fr: Furieux, Byeon Hakdo la fit jeter en prison.
paragraphs.en: In a rage, Byeon Hakdo had her thrown into prison.
paragraphs.kana: 화가 난 변학도는 춘향을 감옥에 가두었어요.
paragraphs.roman: Hwaga nan byeonhakdoneun chunhyangeul gamoge gadueosseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 춘향은 매를 맞으면서도 마음을 바꾸지 않았어요.
paragraphs.fr: Même sous les coups de bâton, Chunhyang ne changea pas d’avis.
paragraphs.en: Even when she was beaten, Chunhyang did not change her mind.
paragraphs.kana: 춘향은 매를 맞으면서도 마음을 바꾸지 않았어요.
paragraphs.roman: Chunhyangeun maereul majeumyeonseodo maeumeul bakkuji anasseoyo.

q.fr: Que demande Byeon Hakdo à Chunhyang ?
q.en: What does Byeon Hakdo demand of Chunhyang?
How does Chunhyang react in prison?

paragraphs.jp: 한편 몽룡은 과거 시험에 장원으로 합격해서 암행어사가 되었어요.
paragraphs.fr: Pendant ce temps, Mongryong réussit le concours en tête et devint inspecteur royal secret.
paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, Mongryong passed the examination in first place and became a secret royal inspector.
paragraphs.kana: 한편 몽룡은 과거 시험에 장원으로 합격해서 암행어사가 되었어요.
paragraphs.roman: Hanpyeon mongryongeun gwageo siheome jangwoneuro hapgyeokhaeseo amhaengeosaga doeeosseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 그는 거지처럼 낡은 옷을 입고 남원에 돌아왔어요.
paragraphs.fr: Il revint à Namwon vêtu de haillons, comme un mendiant.
paragraphs.en: He returned to Namwon dressed in rags, like a beggar.
paragraphs.kana: 그는 거지처럼 낡은 옷을 입고 남원에 돌아왔어요.
paragraphs.roman: Geuneun geojicheoreom nalgeun oseul ipgo namwone dorawasseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 마침 변학도의 생일 잔치가 열리고 있었어요.
paragraphs.fr: Justement, on célébrait l’anniversaire de Byeon Hakdo par un grand banquet.
paragraphs.en: As it happened, Byeon Hakdo’s birthday banquet was under way.
paragraphs.kana: 마침 변학도의 생일 잔치가 열리고 있었어요.
paragraphs.roman: Machim byeonhakdoui saengil janchiga yeolligo isseosseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 「암행어사 출두요!」 소리가 들리자 잔치는 엉망이 되었어요.
paragraphs.fr: Au cri de « Voici l’inspecteur royal ! », le banquet tourna à la débandade.
paragraphs.en: At the cry of “Make way for the royal inspector!”, the banquet fell into chaos.
paragraphs.kana: 「암행어사 출두요!」 소리가 들리자 잔치는 엉망이 되었어요.
paragraphs.roman: “Amhaengeosa chulduyo!” soriga deullija janchineun eongmangi doeeosseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 몽룡은 변학도를 벌하고 춘향을 감옥에서 구했어요. 두 사람은 한양으로 가서 행복하게 살았어요.
paragraphs.fr: Mongryong punit Byeon Hakdo et délivra Chunhyang. Tous deux partirent pour Hanyang et vécurent heureux.
paragraphs.en: Mongryong punished Byeon Hakdo and rescued Chunhyang from prison. The two went to Hanyang and lived happily.
paragraphs.kana: 몽룡은 변학도를 벌하고 춘향을 감옥에서 구했어요. 두 사람은 한양으로 가서 행복하게 살았어요.
paragraphs.roman: Mongryongeun byeonhakdoreul beolhago chunhyangeul gamogeseo guhaesseoyo. Du sarameun hanyangeuro gaseo haengbokhage sarasseoyo.

q.en: How does Mongryong return to Namwon?

q.fr: Que se passe-t-il pendant le banquet ?
q.en: What happens during the banquet?

choices.fr: L’inspecteur royal apparaît et punit Byeon Hakdo
choices.en: The royal inspector appears and punishes Byeon Hakdo

summary.fr: Pour rendre la vue à son père aveugle, une fille dévouée se sacrifie à la mer… et renaît dans une fleur de lotus.
summary.en: To restore her blind father’s sight, a devoted daughter gives herself to the sea… and is reborn in a lotus flower.

title.fr: Le père aveugle et la fille dévouée
title.en: The blind father and the devoted daughter

paragraphs.jp: 옛날 도화동이라는 마을에 심학규라는 눈먼 선비가 살았어요.
paragraphs.fr: Autrefois, au village de Dohwa-dong, vivait un lettré aveugle nommé Sim Hak-gyu.
paragraphs.en: Long ago, in a village called Dohwa-dong, lived a blind scholar named Sim Hak-gyu.
paragraphs.kana: 옛날 도화동이라는 마을에 심학규라는 눈먼 선비가 살았어요.
paragraphs.roman: Yennal dohwadongiraneun maeure simhakgyuraneun nunmeon seonbiga sarasseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 사람들은 그를 심 봉사라고 불렀어요.
paragraphs.fr: On l’appelait « l’aveugle Sim ».
paragraphs.en: People called him “blind Sim”.
paragraphs.kana: 사람들은 그를 심 봉사라고 불렀어요.
paragraphs.roman: Saramdeureun geureul sim bongsarago bulleosseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 아내가 딸 청이를 낳고 세상을 떠나자 심 봉사는 동네를 돌며 젖을 얻어 딸을 키웠어요.
paragraphs.fr: Sa femme mourut après avoir mis au monde leur fille Cheong ; l’aveugle Sim éleva l’enfant en allant mendier du lait dans le voisinage.
paragraphs.en: When his wife died after giving birth to their daughter Cheong, blind Sim raised her by begging milk around the neighbourhood.
paragraphs.kana: 아내가 딸 청이를 낳고 세상을 떠나자 심 봉사는 동네를 돌며 젖을 얻어 딸을 키웠어요.
paragraphs.roman: Anaega ttal cheongireul nako sesangeul tteonaja sim bongsaneun dongnereul dolmyeo jeojeul eodeo ttareul kiwosseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 청이는 자라면서 효심이 깊은 딸이 되었어요.
paragraphs.fr: En grandissant, Cheong devint une fille d’une grande piété filiale.
paragraphs.en: As she grew up, Cheong became a deeply devoted daughter.
paragraphs.kana: 청이는 자라면서 효심이 깊은 딸이 되었어요.
paragraphs.roman: Cheongineun jaramyeonseo hyosimi gipeun ttari doeeosseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 열다섯 살이 되었을 때는 바느질을 해서 번 돈으로 아버지를 정성껏 모셨어요.
paragraphs.fr: À quinze ans, elle prenait soin de son père avec dévouement grâce à l’argent gagné en cousant.
paragraphs.en: By fifteen she was caring devotedly for her father with the money she earned sewing.
paragraphs.kana: 열다섯 살이 되었을 때는 바느질을 해서 번 돈으로 아버지를 정성껏 모셨어요.
paragraphs.roman: Yeoldaseot sari doeeosseul ttaeneun baneujireul haeseo beon doneuro abeojireul jeongseongkkeot mosyeosseoyo.

q.en: How does Sim raise his daughter?

choices.fr: Il mendie du lait aux voisins
choices.en: He begs milk from the neighbours

choices.fr: Il la confie à un temple
choices.en: He leaves her at a temple

q.en: How does Cheong earn money?

paragraphs.jp: 어느 날 딸을 마중 나가던 심 봉사가 개울에 빠졌다가 한 스님에게 구조되었어요.
paragraphs.fr: Un jour, en allant au-devant de sa fille, l’aveugle Sim tomba dans un ruisseau et fut sauvé par un moine.
paragraphs.en: One day, going out to meet his daughter, blind Sim fell into a stream and was rescued by a monk.
paragraphs.kana: 어느 날 딸을 마중 나가던 심 봉사가 개울에 빠졌다가 한 스님에게 구조되었어요.
paragraphs.roman: Eoneu nal ttareul majung nagadeon sim bongsaga gaeure ppajyeotdaga han seunimege gujodoeeosseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 스님은 공양미 삼백 석을 부처님께 바치면 눈을 뜰 수 있을 거라고 했어요.
paragraphs.fr: Le moine lui dit qu’en offrant trois cents sacs de riz au Bouddha, il pourrait retrouver la vue.
paragraphs.en: The monk told him that if he offered three hundred sacks of rice to the Buddha, he would be able to see.
paragraphs.kana: 스님은 공양미 삼백 석을 부처님께 바치면 눈을 뜰 수 있을 거라고 했어요.
paragraphs.roman: Seunimeun gongyangmi sambaek seogeul bucheonimkke bachimyeon nuneul tteul su isseul georago haesseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 심 봉사는 앞뒤 생각 없이 약속하고 말았어요.
paragraphs.fr: Sans réfléchir, l’aveugle Sim le promit.
paragraphs.en: Without thinking, blind Sim made the promise.
paragraphs.kana: 심 봉사는 앞뒤 생각 없이 약속하고 말았어요.
paragraphs.roman: Sim bongsaneun apdwi saenggak eopsi yaksokhago marasseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 하지만 집에 돌아와서는 걱정에 잠겼어요. 가난한 집에서 쌀 삼백 석을 마련할 수 있을 리가 없었으니까요.
paragraphs.fr: Mais de retour chez lui, il fut rongé d’inquiétude : jamais une famille pauvre ne pourrait réunir trois cents sacs de riz.
paragraphs.en: But back home he was filled with worry: a poor household could never come up with three hundred sacks of rice.
paragraphs.kana: 하지만 집에 돌아와서는 걱정에 잠겼어요. 가난한 집에서 쌀 삼백 석을 마련할 수 있을 리가 없었으니까요.
paragraphs.roman: Hajiman jibe dorawaseoneun geokjeonge jamgyeosseoyo. Gananhan jibeseo ssal sambaek seogeul maryeonhal su isseul riga eopseosseunikkayo.

words.en: to come up with, to obtain

q.fr: Que promet l’aveugle Sim au moine ?
q.en: What does blind Sim promise the monk?
Why does he worry afterwards?

choices.fr: Il ne peut pas réunir le riz
choices.en: He cannot come up with the rice

paragraphs.jp: 그 무렵 뱃사람들이 거친 바다 인당수의 신에게 바칠 처녀를 찾고 있었어요.
paragraphs.fr: À cette époque, des marins cherchaient une jeune fille à offrir au dieu des eaux tumultueuses d’Indangsu.
paragraphs.en: At that time, sailors were looking for a maiden to offer to the god of the rough waters of Indangsu.
paragraphs.kana: 그 무렵 뱃사람들이 거친 바다 인당수의 신에게 바칠 처녀를 찾고 있었어요.
paragraphs.roman: Geu muryeop baetsaramdeuri geochin bada indangsuui sinege bachil cheonyeoreul chatgo isseosseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 청이는 쌀 삼백 석을 받는 대신 자기 몸을 팔기로 결심했어요.
paragraphs.fr: Cheong décida de se vendre en échange des trois cents sacs de riz.
paragraphs.en: Cheong resolved to sell herself in exchange for the three hundred sacks of rice.
paragraphs.kana: 청이는 쌀 삼백 석을 받는 대신 자기 몸을 팔기로 결심했어요.
paragraphs.roman: Cheongineun ssal sambaek seogeul banneun daesin jagi momeul palgiro gyeolsimhaesseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 아버지에게는 사실을 숨긴 채 배에 올랐어요.
paragraphs.fr: Elle embarqua en cachant la vérité à son père.
paragraphs.en: She boarded the ship, hiding the truth from her father.
paragraphs.kana: 아버지에게는 사실을 숨긴 채 배에 올랐어요.
paragraphs.roman: Abeojiegeneun sasireul sumgin chae baee ollasseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 파도가 높은 인당수에 이르자 청이는 치마를 뒤집어쓰고 바다에 뛰어들었어요.
paragraphs.fr: Arrivée aux vagues déchaînées d’Indangsu, Cheong se couvrit la tête de sa jupe et sauta dans la mer.
paragraphs.en: When they reached the towering waves of Indangsu, Cheong pulled her skirt over her head and leapt into the sea.
paragraphs.kana: 파도가 높은 인당수에 이르자 청이는 치마를 뒤집어쓰고 바다에 뛰어들었어요.
paragraphs.roman: Padoga nopeun indangsue ireuja cheongineun chimareul dwijibeosseugo badae ttwieodeureosseoyo.

q.en: What are the sailors looking for?

choices.fr: Une jeune fille à offrir à la mer
choices.en: A maiden to offer to the sea

q.fr: Que sait le père du départ de Cheong ?
q.en: What does the father know about Cheong leaving?

choices.fr: Rien, elle lui cache la vérité
choices.en: Nothing, she hides the truth from him

paragraphs.jp: 바닷속 용왕은 청이의 효심에 감동하여 그녀를 커다란 연꽃에 태워 바다 위로 돌려보냈어요.
paragraphs.fr: Le Roi-Dragon des mers, ému par sa piété filiale, la renvoya à la surface dans une immense fleur de lotus.
paragraphs.en: The Dragon King of the sea, moved by her devotion, sent her back to the surface inside a huge lotus flower.
paragraphs.kana: 바닷속 용왕은 청이의 효심에 감동하여 그녀를 커다란 연꽃에 태워 바다 위로 돌려보냈어요.
paragraphs.roman: Badatsok yongwangeun cheongiui hyosime gamdonghayeo geunyeoreul keodaran yeonkkoche taewo bada wiro dollyeobonaesseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 연꽃을 발견한 임금은 청이를 왕비로 맞이했어요.
paragraphs.fr: Le roi découvrit la fleur et prit Cheong pour reine.
paragraphs.en: The king who found the lotus took Cheong as his queen.
paragraphs.kana: 연꽃을 발견한 임금은 청이를 왕비로 맞이했어요.
paragraphs.roman: Yeonkkocheul balgyeonhan imgeumeun cheongireul wangbiro majihaesseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 왕비가 된 청이는 아버지를 찾으려고 전국의 맹인들을 위한 잔치를 열었어요.
paragraphs.fr: Devenue reine, Cheong organisa un banquet pour tous les aveugles du pays, afin de retrouver son père.
paragraphs.en: Now queen, Cheong held a banquet for all the blind people of the land in order to find her father.
paragraphs.kana: 왕비가 된 청이는 아버지를 찾으려고 전국의 맹인들을 위한 잔치를 열었어요.
paragraphs.roman: Wangbiga doen cheongineun abeojireul chajeuryeogo jeongugui maengindeureul wihan janchireul yeoreosseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 딸의 목소리를 들은 심 봉사는 너무 놀라 눈을 번쩍 떴어요.
paragraphs.fr: En entendant la voix de sa fille, l’aveugle Sim fut si saisi que ses yeux s’ouvrirent d’un coup.
paragraphs.en: Hearing his daughter’s voice, blind Sim was so astonished that his eyes flew open.
paragraphs.kana: 딸의 목소리를 들은 심 봉사는 너무 놀라 눈을 번쩍 떴어요.
paragraphs.roman: Ttarui moksorireul deureun sim bongsaneun neomu nolla nuneul beonjjeok tteosseoyo.

q.fr: Comment Cheong revient-elle à la surface ?
q.en: How does Cheong return to the surface?
Why does she hold a banquet?

summary.fr: Fils d’un ministre mais né d’une servante, Hong Gildong ne peut ni appeler son père « père », ni servir l’État. Il devient le chef de bandits justiciers qui volent les riches corrompus.
summary.en: The son of a minister but born to a servant, Hong Gildong may neither call his father “father” nor serve the state. He becomes the leader of righteous outlaws who rob corrupt officials.

title.fr: Ne pas pouvoir appeler son père « père »
title.en: Not allowed to call his father “father”

paragraphs.jp: 조선 시대에 홍 판서의 아들 홍길동이 태어났어요.
paragraphs.fr: À l’époque Joseon naquit Hong Gildong, fils du ministre Hong.
paragraphs.en: In the Joseon era, Hong Gildong was born, the son of Minister Hong.
paragraphs.kana: 조선 시대에 홍 판서의 아들 홍길동이 태어났어요.
paragraphs.roman: Joseon sidaee hong panseoui adeul honggildongi taeeonasseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 길동은 어릴 때부터 머리가 좋고 무술도 잘했지만, 어머니가 하녀였던 탓에 서자로 차별을 받았어요.
paragraphs.fr: Dès l’enfance, Gildong était brillant et excellait aux arts martiaux, mais parce que sa mère était servante, il subissait le mépris réservé aux fils illégitimes.
paragraphs.en: From childhood Gildong was clever and skilled in martial arts, but because his mother was a maid he was discriminated against as an illegitimate son.
paragraphs.kana: 길동은 어릴 때부터 머리가 좋고 무술도 잘했지만, 어머니가 하녀였던 탓에 서자로 차별을 받았어요.
paragraphs.roman: Gildongeun eoril ttaebuteo meoriga joko musuldo jalhaetjiman, eomeoniga hanyeoyeotdeon tase seojaro chabyeoreul badasseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 그는 아버지를 아버지라 부르지 못하고, 형을 형이라 부르지 못했어요.
paragraphs.fr: Il ne pouvait appeler son père « père », ni son frère « grand frère ».
paragraphs.en: He could not call his father “father”, nor his brother “big brother”.
paragraphs.kana: 그는 아버지를 아버지라 부르지 못하고, 형을 형이라 부르지 못했어요.
paragraphs.roman: Geuneun abeojireul abeojira bureuji mothago, hyeongeul hyeongira bureuji mothaesseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 「아무리 노력하더라도 저는 벼슬을 할 수 없겠지요.」
paragraphs.fr: « J’aurai beau faire des efforts, je ne pourrai jamais devenir fonctionnaire. »
paragraphs.en: “However hard I try, I will never be able to hold office.”
paragraphs.kana: 「아무리 노력하더라도 저는 벼슬을 할 수 없겠지요.」
paragraphs.roman: “Amuri noryeokhadeorado jeoneun byeoseureul hal su eopgetjiyo.”

paragraphs.jp: 길동은 결국 집을 떠나기로 결심했어요.
paragraphs.fr: Gildong finit par décider de quitter la maison.
paragraphs.en: In the end, Gildong made up his mind to leave home.
paragraphs.kana: 길동은 결국 집을 떠나기로 결심했어요.
paragraphs.roman: Gildongeun gyeolguk jibeul tteonagiro gyeolsimhaesseoyo.

q.en: Why is Gildong treated differently?
What does he finally decide?

paragraphs.jp: 집을 떠난 길동은 산속에서 도적들을 만났어요.
paragraphs.fr: Après avoir quitté la maison, Gildong rencontra des brigands dans la montagne.
paragraphs.en: After leaving home, Gildong met a band of outlaws in the mountains.
paragraphs.kana: 집을 떠난 길동은 산속에서 도적들을 만났어요.
paragraphs.roman: Jibeul tteonan gildongeun sansogeseo dojeokdeureul mannasseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 도적들은 커다란 돌을 들어 올리는 사람을 두목으로 삼겠다고 했어요.
paragraphs.fr: Les brigands déclarèrent qu’ils prendraient pour chef celui qui soulèverait un énorme rocher.
paragraphs.en: The outlaws said they would make whoever could lift a huge rock their leader.
paragraphs.kana: 도적들은 커다란 돌을 들어 올리는 사람을 두목으로 삼겠다고 했어요.
paragraphs.roman: Dojeokdeureun keodaran doreul deureo ollineun sarameul dumogeuro samgetdago haesseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 길동은 그 돌을 가볍게 들어 올리고 두목이 되었어요.
paragraphs.fr: Gildong souleva le rocher sans effort et devint leur chef.
paragraphs.en: Gildong lifted the rock with ease and became their leader.
paragraphs.kana: 길동은 그 돌을 가볍게 들어 올리고 두목이 되었어요.
paragraphs.roman: Gildongeun geu doreul gabyeopge deureo olligo dumogi doeeosseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 길동은 무리의 이름을 「활빈당」이라고 지었어요. 가난한 백성을 살리는 무리라는 뜻이에요.
paragraphs.fr: Gildong appela la bande « Hwalbindang », ce qui signifie « la bande qui sauve les pauvres ».
paragraphs.en: Gildong named the band the “Hwalbindang”, meaning “the band that saves the poor”.
paragraphs.kana: 길동은 무리의 이름을 「활빈당」이라고 지었어요. 가난한 백성을 살리는 무리라는 뜻이에요.
paragraphs.roman: Gildongeun muriui ireumeul “Hwalbindang”irago jieosseoyo. Gananhan baekseongeul sallineun muriraneun tteusieyo.

paragraphs.jp: 활빈당은 백성의 재물을 빼앗은 욕심 많은 관리들의 창고만 털었어요.
paragraphs.fr: La Hwalbindang ne pillait que les entrepôts des fonctionnaires cupides qui avaient dépouillé le peuple.
paragraphs.en: The Hwalbindang only raided the storehouses of greedy officials who had robbed the people.
paragraphs.kana: 활빈당은 백성의 재물을 빼앗은 욕심 많은 관리들의 창고만 털었어요.
paragraphs.roman: Hwalbindangeun baekseongui jaemureul ppaeaseun yoksim maneun gwallideurui changgoman teoreosseoyo.

q.en: How does Gildong become leader?

choices.fr: En gagnant un combat à l’épée

q.en: Whom does the Hwalbindang rob?

paragraphs.jp: 나라에서는 길동을 잡으려고 군사를 보냈지만 소용없었어요.
paragraphs.fr: Le royaume envoya des soldats pour capturer Gildong, mais en vain.
paragraphs.en: The kingdom sent soldiers to capture Gildong, but it was no use.
paragraphs.kana: 나라에서는 길동을 잡으려고 군사를 보냈지만 소용없었어요.
paragraphs.roman: Naraeseoneun gildongeul jabeuryeogo gunsareul bonaetjiman soyongeopseosseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 길동은 도술을 부려 짚으로 여덟 명의 길동을 만들었어요.
paragraphs.fr: Par magie, Gildong fabriqua avec de la paille huit autres Gildong.
paragraphs.en: Using magic, Gildong made eight Gildongs out of straw.
paragraphs.kana: 길동은 도술을 부려 짚으로 여덟 명의 길동을 만들었어요.
paragraphs.roman: Gildongeun dosureul buryeo jipeuro yeodeol myeongui gildongeul mandeureosseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 여덟 명의 길동이 전국 곳곳에 나타나는 바람에 아무도 진짜 길동을 찾을 수 없었어요.
paragraphs.fr: Comme huit Gildong apparaissaient partout dans le pays, personne ne put trouver le vrai.
paragraphs.en: Because eight Gildongs appeared all over the country, no one could find the real one.
paragraphs.kana: 여덟 명의 길동이 전국 곳곳에 나타나는 바람에 아무도 진짜 길동을 찾을 수 없었어요.
paragraphs.roman: Yeodeol myeongui gildongi jeonguk gotgose natananeun barame amudo jinjja gildongeul chajeul su eopseosseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 결국 왕은 길동의 형에게 길동을 잡아 오라고 명령했어요.
paragraphs.fr: Finalement, le roi ordonna au frère aîné de Gildong de le capturer.
paragraphs.en: In the end, the king ordered Gildong’s older brother to bring him in.
paragraphs.kana: 결국 왕은 길동의 형에게 길동을 잡아 오라고 명령했어요.
paragraphs.roman: Gyeolguk wangeun gildongui hyeongege gildongeul jaba orago myeongryeonghaesseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 형이 아버지가 병이 났다는 편지를 보내자 길동은 스스로 잡혀 왔어요.
paragraphs.fr: Quand son frère lui écrivit que leur père était tombé malade, Gildong se laissa prendre de lui-même.
paragraphs.en: When his brother wrote that their father had fallen ill, Gildong let himself be caught.
paragraphs.kana: 형이 아버지가 병이 났다는 편지를 보내자 길동은 스스로 잡혀 왔어요.
paragraphs.roman: Hyeongi abeojiga byeongi natdaneun pyeonjireul bonaeja gildongeun seuseuro japhyeo wasseoyo.

words.en: by oneself, of one’s own accord

q.fr: Pourquoi personne ne trouve-t-il le vrai Gildong ?
q.en: Why can no one find the real Gildong?

choices.fr: Huit Gildong de paille apparaissent partout

q.en: Why does Gildong let himself be caught?

choices.fr: Le roi lui offre de l’argent

paragraphs.jp: 왕은 길동의 재주를 보고 그에게 병조 판서라는 높은 벼슬을 주었어요.
paragraphs.fr: Voyant ses talents, le roi lui accorda une haute charge : ministre de la Guerre.
paragraphs.en: Seeing his talents, the king gave him a high post: Minister of War.
paragraphs.kana: 왕은 길동의 재주를 보고 그에게 병조 판서라는 높은 벼슬을 주었어요.
paragraphs.roman: Wangeun gildongui jaejureul bogo geuege byeongjo panseoraneun nopeun byeoseureul jueosseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 길동은 왕에게 감사의 인사를 드린 후 무리를 데리고 조선을 떠났어요.
paragraphs.fr: Après avoir remercié le roi, Gildong quitta Joseon avec sa bande.
paragraphs.en: After thanking the king, Gildong left Joseon with his band.
paragraphs.kana: 길동은 왕에게 감사의 인사를 드린 후 무리를 데리고 조선을 떠났어요.
paragraphs.roman: Gildongeun wangege gamsaui insareul deurin hu murireul derigo joseoneul tteonasseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 그들은 바다 건너 율도국이라는 섬나라에 도착했어요.
paragraphs.fr: Ils arrivèrent de l’autre côté de la mer, dans un royaume insulaire nommé Yuldo.
paragraphs.en: They arrived across the sea in an island kingdom called Yuldo.
paragraphs.kana: 그들은 바다 건너 율도국이라는 섬나라에 도착했어요.
paragraphs.roman: Geudeureun bada geonneo yuldogugiraneun seomnarae dochakhaesseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 길동은 그곳의 왕이 되어 신분의 차별이 없는 나라를 만들었어요.
paragraphs.fr: Gildong en devint le roi et y fonda un pays sans discrimination de naissance.
paragraphs.en: Gildong became its king and built a country without discrimination by birth.
paragraphs.kana: 길동은 그곳의 왕이 되어 신분의 차별이 없는 나라를 만들었어요.
paragraphs.roman: Gildongeun geugosui wangi doeeo sinbunui chabyeori eomneun narareul mandeureosseoyo.

paragraphs.jp: 사람들은 지금도 홍길동을 정의로운 영웅으로 기억하고 있어요.
paragraphs.fr: Aujourd’hui encore, on se souvient de Hong Gildong comme d’un héros juste.
paragraphs.en: People still remember Hong Gildong as a righteous hero.
paragraphs.kana: 사람들은 지금도 홍길동을 정의로운 영웅으로 기억하고 있어요.
paragraphs.roman: Saramdeureun jigeumdo honggildongeul jeonguiroun yeongungeuro gieokhago isseoyo.

q.fr: Quelle charge le roi donne-t-il à Gildong ?
q.en: What post does the king give Gildong?

q.fr: Quel pays Gildong fonde-t-il à Yuldo ?
q.en: What kind of country does Gildong build in Yuldo?

choices.fr: Un pays sans discrimination de naissance
choices.en: A country without discrimination by birth

summary.fr: Abandonnée à la naissance parce qu’elle n’était pas un fils, la septième princesse descend pourtant au royaume des morts pour sauver le père qui l’a rejetée.
summary.en: Abandoned at birth because she was not a son, the seventh princess nonetheless goes down to the realm of the dead to save the father who rejected her.

paragraphs.jp: 옛날 어느 나라의 왕과 왕비는 아들을 간절히 원했지만 딸만 여섯을 낳았다.
paragraphs.fr: Il était une fois un roi et une reine qui désiraient ardemment un fils, mais n’eurent que six filles.
paragraphs.en: Long ago, a king and queen longed for a son but had only six daughters.
paragraphs.kana: 옛날 어느 나라의 왕과 왕비는 아들을 간절히 원했지만 딸만 여섯을 낳았다.
paragraphs.roman: Yennal eoneu naraui wanggwa wangbineun adeureul ganjeolhi wonhaetjiman ttalman yeoseoseul naatda.

paragraphs.jp: 일곱째도 딸이 태어나자 왕은 크게 실망한 나머지 아기를 버리라고 명령했다.
paragraphs.fr: Quand la septième naquit fille elle aussi, le roi, profondément déçu, ordonna qu’on l’abandonne.
paragraphs.en: When the seventh was also a girl, the king, bitterly disappointed, ordered the baby to be abandoned.
paragraphs.kana: 일곱째도 딸이 태어나자 왕은 크게 실망한 나머지 아기를 버리라고 명령했다.
paragraphs.roman: Ilgopjjaedo ttari taeeonaja wangeun keuge silmanghan nameoji agireul beorirago myeongryeonghaetda.

paragraphs.jp: 아기는 옥으로 만든 상자에 담겨 바다에 버려졌다.
paragraphs.fr: Le bébé fut placé dans un coffre de jade et jeté à la mer.
paragraphs.en: The baby was put in a jade box and cast into the sea.
paragraphs.kana: 아기는 옥으로 만든 상자에 담겨 바다에 버려졌다.
paragraphs.roman: Agineun ogeuro mandeun sangjae damgyeo badae beoryeojyeotda.

paragraphs.jp: 그러나 바다의 거북이 상자를 등에 업고 바닷가로 데려다주었다.
paragraphs.fr: Mais une tortue de mer porta le coffre sur son dos jusqu’au rivage.
paragraphs.en: But a sea turtle carried the box on its back to the shore.
paragraphs.kana: 그러나 바다의 거북이 상자를 등에 업고 바닷가로 데려다주었다.
paragraphs.roman: Geureona badaui geobugi sangjareul deunge eopgo badatgaro deryeodajueotda.

paragraphs.jp: 가난한 노부부가 아기를 발견하고 「버려진 아이」라는 뜻으로 바리라고 불렀다.
paragraphs.fr: Un vieux couple pauvre trouva l’enfant et l’appela Bari, « l’abandonnée ».
paragraphs.en: A poor old couple found the child and named her Bari, meaning “the abandoned one”.
paragraphs.kana: 가난한 노부부가 아기를 발견하고 「버려진 아이」라는 뜻으로 바리라고 불렀다.
paragraphs.roman: Gananhan nobubuga agireul balgyeonhago “Beoryeojin ai”raneun tteuseuro barirago bulleotda.

q.fr: Pourquoi le roi abandonne-t-il le bébé ?
q.en: Why does the king abandon the baby?
What does the name “Bari” mean?

paragraphs.jp: 십오 년이 지나 왕과 왕비가 큰 병에 걸렸다.
paragraphs.fr: Quinze ans plus tard, le roi et la reine tombèrent gravement malades.
paragraphs.en: Fifteen years later, the king and queen fell gravely ill.
paragraphs.kana: 십오 년이 지나 왕과 왕비가 큰 병에 걸렸다.
paragraphs.roman: Sibo nyeoni jina wanggwa wangbiga keun byeonge geollyeotda.

paragraphs.jp: 점쟁이는 저승에 있는 생명수를 마셔야만 병이 나을 수 있다고 말했다.
paragraphs.fr: Le devin déclara que seule l’eau de vie de l’au-delà pourrait les guérir.
paragraphs.en: The fortune-teller said only the water of life from the afterlife could cure them.
paragraphs.kana: 점쟁이는 저승에 있는 생명수를 마셔야만 병이 나을 수 있다고 말했다.
paragraphs.roman: Jeomjaengineun jeoseunge inneun saengmyeongsureul masyeoyaman byeongi naeul su itdago malhaetda.

paragraphs.jp: 그러나 여섯 공주는 저마다 핑계를 대며 아무도 가려고 하지 않았다.
paragraphs.fr: Mais les six princesses trouvèrent chacune un prétexte, et aucune ne voulut y aller.
paragraphs.en: But each of the six princesses made an excuse, and none was willing to go.
paragraphs.kana: 그러나 여섯 공주는 저마다 핑계를 대며 아무도 가려고 하지 않았다.
paragraphs.roman: Geureona yeoseot gongjuneun jeomada pinggyereul daemyeo amudo garyeogo haji anatda.

paragraphs.jp: 소식을 들은 바리는 자신을 버린 부모를 원망하기는커녕 「제가 가겠습니다.」라고 말했다.
paragraphs.fr: En apprenant la nouvelle, Bari, loin d’en vouloir aux parents qui l’avaient abandonnée, déclara : « J’irai. »
paragraphs.en: On hearing the news, Bari, far from resenting the parents who had abandoned her, said: “I will go.”
paragraphs.kana: 소식을 들은 바리는 자신을 버린 부모를 원망하기는커녕 「제가 가겠습니다.」라고 말했다.
paragraphs.roman: Sosigeul deureun barineun jasineul beorin bumoreul wonmanghagineunkeonyeong “Jega gagetseumnida.”rago malhaetda.

paragraphs.jp: 낳아 준 은혜를 갚는 것이 자식의 도리라고 생각했기 때문이다.
paragraphs.fr: Car elle pensait qu’un enfant doit rendre le bienfait de la vie reçue.
paragraphs.en: For she believed it was a child’s duty to repay the gift of life.
paragraphs.kana: 낳아 준 은혜를 갚는 것이 자식의 도리라고 생각했기 때문이다.
paragraphs.roman: Naa jun eunhyereul gamneun geosi jasigui dorirago saenggakhaetgi ttaemunida.

q.fr: Que faut-il pour guérir le roi ?
q.en: What is needed to cure the king?

choices.en: The water of life from the afterlife

q.en: How does Bari react?

paragraphs.jp: 바리는 남자 옷을 입고 홀로 저승을 향해 길을 떠났다.
paragraphs.fr: Vêtue en homme, Bari partit seule vers l’au-delà.
paragraphs.en: Dressed as a man, Bari set out alone for the afterlife.
paragraphs.kana: 바리는 남자 옷을 입고 홀로 저승을 향해 길을 떠났다.
paragraphs.roman: Barineun namja oseul ipgo hollo jeoseungeul hyanghae gireul tteonatda.

paragraphs.jp: 험한 산을 넘고 가시밭길을 지나며 끝없이 걸었다.
paragraphs.fr: Elle franchit des montagnes escarpées, traversa des chemins d’épines et marcha sans fin.
paragraphs.en: She crossed steep mountains and paths of thorns, walking on and on.
paragraphs.kana: 험한 산을 넘고 가시밭길을 지나며 끝없이 걸었다.
paragraphs.roman: Heomhan saneul neomgo gasibatgireul jinamyeo kkeuteopsi georeotda.

paragraphs.jp: 저승의 강가에 이르자 죄 많은 넋들이 울고 있었다.
paragraphs.fr: Arrivée au bord du fleuve des morts, elle trouva des âmes chargées de fautes qui pleuraient.
paragraphs.en: When she reached the river of the dead, sinful souls were weeping there.
paragraphs.kana: 저승의 강가에 이르자 죄 많은 넋들이 울고 있었다.
paragraphs.roman: Jeoseungui ganggae ireuja joe maneun neokdeuri ulgo isseotda.

paragraphs.jp: 바리는 그 넋들을 불쌍히 여겨 극락으로 보내 주었다.
paragraphs.fr: Prise de pitié, Bari les envoya au paradis.
paragraphs.en: Taking pity on them, Bari sent them on to paradise.
paragraphs.kana: 바리는 그 넋들을 불쌍히 여겨 극락으로 보내 주었다.
paragraphs.roman: Barineun geu neokdeureul bulssanghi yeogyeo geukrageuro bonae jueotda.

paragraphs.jp: 마침내 생명수를 지키는 무장승을 만났다.
paragraphs.fr: Enfin, elle rencontra Mujangseung, gardien de l’eau de vie.
paragraphs.en: At last she met Mujangseung, guardian of the water of life.
paragraphs.kana: 마침내 생명수를 지키는 무장승을 만났다.
paragraphs.roman: Machimnae saengmyeongsureul jikineun mujangseungeul mannatda.

q.en: How does Bari travel?

q.fr: Que fait-elle pour les âmes qui pleurent ?
q.en: What does she do for the weeping souls?

title.fr: L’eau de vie et la princesse devenue déesse
title.en: The water of life and the princess who became a goddess

paragraphs.jp: 무장승은 생명수를 주는 대신에 구 년 동안 일하라고 했다.
paragraphs.fr: Mujangseung exigea neuf ans de travail en échange de l’eau de vie.
paragraphs.en: Mujangseung demanded nine years of work in exchange for the water of life.
paragraphs.kana: 무장승은 생명수를 주는 대신에 구 년 동안 일하라고 했다.
paragraphs.roman: Mujangseungeun saengmyeongsureul juneun daesine gu nyeon dongan ilharago haetda.

paragraphs.jp: 바리는 물을 긷고 나무를 하며 구 년을 견뎠고, 무장승과 혼인하여 아들도 낳았다.
paragraphs.fr: Bari puisa l’eau et coupa le bois pendant neuf ans ; elle épousa Mujangseung et lui donna des fils.
paragraphs.en: Bari drew water and cut wood for nine years, married Mujangseung and bore him sons.
paragraphs.kana: 바리는 물을 긷고 나무를 하며 구 년을 견뎠고, 무장승과 혼인하여 아들도 낳았다.
paragraphs.roman: Barineun mureul gitgo namureul hamyeo gu nyeoneul gyeondyeotgo, mujangseunggwa honinhayeo adeuldo naatda.

paragraphs.jp: 마침내 생명수와 되살리는 꽃을 얻어 이승으로 돌아왔다.
paragraphs.fr: Enfin, elle obtint l’eau de vie et les fleurs de résurrection et revint dans le monde des vivants.
paragraphs.en: At last she obtained the water of life and the flowers of revival and returned to the world of the living.
paragraphs.kana: 마침내 생명수와 되살리는 꽃을 얻어 이승으로 돌아왔다.
paragraphs.roman: Machimnae saengmyeongsuwa doesallineun kkocheul eodeo iseungeuro dorawatda.

paragraphs.jp: 그러나 왕과 왕비는 이미 숨을 거둔 뒤였다.
paragraphs.fr: Mais le roi et la reine avaient déjà rendu leur dernier souffle.
paragraphs.en: But the king and queen had already breathed their last.
paragraphs.kana: 그러나 왕과 왕비는 이미 숨을 거둔 뒤였다.
paragraphs.roman: Geureona wanggwa wangbineun imi sumeul geodun dwiyeotda.

paragraphs.jp: 바리가 꽃과 생명수를 바르자 두 사람은 기적처럼 다시 눈을 떴다.
paragraphs.fr: Quand Bari les oignit des fleurs et de l’eau de vie, ils rouvrirent les yeux, comme par miracle.
paragraphs.en: When Bari applied the flowers and the water of life, the two opened their eyes again, as if by miracle.
paragraphs.kana: 바리가 꽃과 생명수를 바르자 두 사람은 기적처럼 다시 눈을 떴다.
paragraphs.roman: Bariga kkotgwa saengmyeongsureul bareuja du sarameun gijeokcheoreom dasi nuneul tteotda.

paragraphs.jp: 그 후 바리는 죽은 이의 넋을 저승으로 인도하는 신이 되었다.
paragraphs.fr: Bari devint ensuite la déesse qui guide les âmes des morts vers l’au-delà.
paragraphs.en: Bari then became the goddess who guides the souls of the dead to the afterlife.
paragraphs.kana: 그 후 바리는 죽은 이의 넋을 저승으로 인도하는 신이 되었다.
paragraphs.roman: Geu hu barineun jugeun iui neokseul jeoseungeuro indohaneun sini doeeotda.

words.en: this world, the world of the living

q.en: What does Mujangseung ask in exchange?

q.fr: Que devient Bari à la fin ?
q.en: What does Bari become in the end?

choices.fr: La déesse qui guide les âmes

summary.fr: Le mythe fondateur de la Corée : le fils du Ciel, l’ourse devenue femme et la naissance de Gojoseon, le premier royaume.
summary.en: Korea’s founding myth: the son of Heaven, the bear who became a woman, and the birth of Gojoseon, the first kingdom.

paragraphs.jp: 아주 먼 옛날, 하늘을 다스리는 환인에게는 환웅이라는 아들이 있었다.
paragraphs.fr: Il y a très, très longtemps, Hwanin, maître du Ciel, avait un fils nommé Hwanung.
paragraphs.en: Long, long ago, Hwanin, ruler of Heaven, had a son named Hwanung.
paragraphs.kana: 아주 먼 옛날, 하늘을 다스리는 환인에게는 환웅이라는 아들이 있었다.
paragraphs.roman: Aju meon yennal, haneureul daseurineun hwaninegeneun hwanungiraneun adeuri isseotda.

paragraphs.jp: 환웅은 늘 인간 세상을 내려다보며 그곳을 다스리고자 하였다.
paragraphs.fr: Hwanung contemplait sans cesse le monde des hommes et désirait le gouverner.
paragraphs.en: Hwanung always gazed down on the human world and wished to govern it.
paragraphs.kana: 환웅은 늘 인간 세상을 내려다보며 그곳을 다스리고자 하였다.
paragraphs.roman: Hwanungeun neul ingan sesangeul naeryeodabomyeo geugoseul daseurigoja hayeotda.

paragraphs.jp: 환인은 아들의 뜻을 알고 인간을 널리 이롭게 할 만하다고 여겨 허락하였다.
paragraphs.fr: Connaissant son désir et jugeant qu’il pourrait apporter de grands bienfaits aux hommes, Hwanin y consentit.
paragraphs.en: Knowing his wish and judging that he could greatly benefit humankind, Hwanin gave his consent.
paragraphs.kana: 환인은 아들의 뜻을 알고 인간을 널리 이롭게 할 만하다고 여겨 허락하였다.
paragraphs.roman: Hwanineun adeurui tteuseul algo inganeul neolli iropge hal manhadago yeogyeo heorakhayeotda.

paragraphs.jp: 환웅은 바람과 비와 구름을 다스리는 신하들과 무리 삼천을 이끌고 태백산 꼭대기 신단수 아래로 내려왔다.
paragraphs.fr: Avec les ministres du vent, de la pluie et des nuages et trois mille compagnons, Hwanung descendit au sommet du mont Taebaek, sous l’arbre sacré du santal.
paragraphs.en: Leading the ministers of wind, rain and cloud and three thousand followers, Hwanung descended to the summit of Mount Taebaek, beneath the sacred sandalwood tree.
paragraphs.kana: 환웅은 바람과 비와 구름을 다스리는 신하들과 무리 삼천을 이끌고 태백산 꼭대기 신단수 아래로 내려왔다.
paragraphs.roman: Hwanungeun baramgwa biwa gureumeul daseurineun sinhadeulgwa muri samcheoneul ikkeulgo taebaeksan kkokdaegi sindansu araero naeryeowatda.

paragraphs.jp: 그곳을 신시라 부르며 세상을 다스렸다.
paragraphs.fr: Il nomma ce lieu Sinsi, la cité divine, et gouverna le monde.
paragraphs.en: He called the place Sinsi, the divine city, and ruled the world.
paragraphs.kana: 그곳을 신시라 부르며 세상을 다스렸다.
paragraphs.roman: Geugoseul sinsira bureumyeo sesangeul daseuryeotda.

q.en: Why does Hwanung want to come down?

choices.fr: Pour gouverner le monde des hommes

q.en: Where does he come down?

choices.en: On the summit of Mount Taebaek

paragraphs.jp: 그때 한 동굴에 사는 곰과 호랑이가 환웅에게 사람이 되게 해 달라고 빌었다.
paragraphs.fr: Alors, une ourse et un tigre qui vivaient dans une caverne supplièrent Hwanung de les rendre humains.
paragraphs.en: At that time, a bear and a tiger living in a cave begged Hwanung to make them human.
paragraphs.kana: 그때 한 동굴에 사는 곰과 호랑이가 환웅에게 사람이 되게 해 달라고 빌었다.
paragraphs.roman: Geuttae han donggure saneun gomgwa horangiga hwanungege sarami doege hae dallago bireotda.

paragraphs.jp: 환웅은 쑥 한 묶음과 마늘 스무 개를 주며 말했다.
paragraphs.fr: Hwanung leur donna une botte d’armoise et vingt gousses d’ail, et dit :
paragraphs.en: Hwanung gave them a bundle of mugwort and twenty cloves of garlic, and said:
paragraphs.kana: 환웅은 쑥 한 묶음과 마늘 스무 개를 주며 말했다.
paragraphs.roman: Hwanungeun ssuk han mukkeumgwa maneul seumu gaereul jumyeo malhaetda.

paragraphs.jp: 「이것을 먹으며 백 일 동안 햇빛을 보지 않으면 사람이 될 것이다.」
paragraphs.fr: « Mangez ceci et ne voyez pas la lumière du soleil pendant cent jours : vous deviendrez humains. »
paragraphs.en: “Eat this and do not see sunlight for a hundred days, and you will become human.”
paragraphs.kana: 「이것을 먹으며 백 일 동안 햇빛을 보지 않으면 사람이 될 것이다.」
paragraphs.roman: “Igeoseul meogeumyeo baek il dongan haetbicheul boji aneumyeon sarami doel geosida.”

paragraphs.jp: 호랑이는 참지 못하고 동굴을 뛰쳐나갔다.
paragraphs.fr: Le tigre, incapable de patienter, s’enfuit de la caverne.
paragraphs.en: The tiger could not bear it and ran out of the cave.
paragraphs.kana: 호랑이는 참지 못하고 동굴을 뛰쳐나갔다.
paragraphs.roman: Horangineun chamji mothago donggureul ttwichyeonagatda.

paragraphs.jp: 그러나 곰은 끝까지 견뎌 스무하루 만에 여자가 되었다. 그녀가 바로 웅녀이다.
paragraphs.fr: Mais l’ourse tint bon jusqu’au bout et, au vingt et unième jour, devint une femme : Ungnyeo.
paragraphs.en: But the bear endured to the end and on the twenty-first day became a woman: Ungnyeo.
paragraphs.kana: 그러나 곰은 끝까지 견뎌 스무하루 만에 여자가 되었다. 그녀가 바로 웅녀이다.
paragraphs.roman: Geureona gomeun kkeutkkaji gyeondyeo seumuharu mane yeojaga doeeotda. Geunyeoga baro ungnyeoida.

q.fr: Que doivent manger l’ourse et le tigre ?
q.en: What must the bear and tiger eat?
What does the tiger do?

choices.en: He runs out of the cave

paragraphs.jp: 사람이 된 웅녀는 혼인할 사람이 없어 매일 신단수 아래에서 아이를 갖게 해 달라고 빌었다.
paragraphs.fr: Devenue femme mais sans personne à épouser, Ungnyeo priait chaque jour sous l’arbre sacré pour avoir un enfant.
paragraphs.en: Having become a woman but with no one to marry, Ungnyeo prayed every day beneath the sacred tree for a child.
paragraphs.kana: 사람이 된 웅녀는 혼인할 사람이 없어 매일 신단수 아래에서 아이를 갖게 해 달라고 빌었다.
paragraphs.roman: Sarami doen ungnyeoneun honinhal sarami eopseo maeil sindansu araeeseo aireul gatge hae dallago bireotda.

paragraphs.jp: 환웅은 잠시 사람의 모습으로 변하여 웅녀와 혼인하였다.
paragraphs.fr: Hwanung prit un temps forme humaine et l’épousa.
paragraphs.en: Hwanung briefly took human form and married her.
paragraphs.kana: 환웅은 잠시 사람의 모습으로 변하여 웅녀와 혼인하였다.
paragraphs.roman: Hwanungeun jamsi saramui moseubeuro byeonhayeo ungnyeowa honinhayeotda.

paragraphs.jp: 그리하여 아들이 태어났는데, 그가 바로 단군왕검이다.
paragraphs.fr: Ainsi naquit un fils : Dangun Wanggeom.
paragraphs.en: Thus a son was born: Dangun Wanggeom.
paragraphs.kana: 그리하여 아들이 태어났는데, 그가 바로 단군왕검이다.
paragraphs.roman: Geurihayeo adeuri taeeonanneunde, geuga baro dangunwanggeomida.

paragraphs.jp: 단군은 자라면서 하늘의 지혜와 땅의 인내를 모두 갖추게 되었다.
paragraphs.fr: En grandissant, Dangun réunit la sagesse du ciel et la persévérance de la terre.
paragraphs.en: As he grew, Dangun came to possess both the wisdom of heaven and the perseverance of the earth.
paragraphs.kana: 단군은 자라면서 하늘의 지혜와 땅의 인내를 모두 갖추게 되었다.
paragraphs.roman: Danguneun jaramyeonseo haneurui jihyewa ttangui innaereul modu gatchuge doeeotda.

q.en: What does Ungnyeo pray for?

q.fr: Qui sont les parents de Dangun ?
q.en: Who are Dangun’s parents?

paragraphs.jp: 단군왕검은 평양성에 도읍을 정하고 나라 이름을 조선이라 하였다.
paragraphs.fr: Dangun Wanggeom établit sa capitale à Pyongyang et nomma son pays Joseon.
paragraphs.en: Dangun Wanggeom set his capital at Pyongyang and named his country Joseon.
paragraphs.kana: 단군왕검은 평양성에 도읍을 정하고 나라 이름을 조선이라 하였다.
paragraphs.roman: Dangunwanggeomeun pyeongyangseonge doeubeul jeonghago nara ireumeul joseonira hayeotda.

paragraphs.jp: 후대의 조선과 구별하여 이 나라를 고조선이라 부른다.
paragraphs.fr: Pour le distinguer du Joseon plus tardif, on l’appelle Gojoseon, « l’ancien Joseon ».
paragraphs.en: To distinguish it from the later Joseon, it is called Gojoseon, “Old Joseon”.
paragraphs.kana: 후대의 조선과 구별하여 이 나라를 고조선이라 부른다.
paragraphs.roman: Hudaeui joseongwa gubyeolhayeo i narareul gojoseonira bureunda.

paragraphs.jp: 단군은 천오백 년 동안 나라를 다스린 후 산으로 들어가 산신이 되었다고 전해진다.
paragraphs.fr: On raconte qu’après avoir régné mille cinq cents ans, Dangun se retira dans la montagne et devint l’esprit des monts.
paragraphs.en: It is said that after ruling for 1,500 years, Dangun withdrew into the mountains and became a mountain god.
paragraphs.kana: 단군은 천오백 년 동안 나라를 다스린 후 산으로 들어가 산신이 되었다고 전해진다.
paragraphs.roman: Danguneun cheonobaek nyeon dongan narareul daseurin hu saneuro deureoga sansini doeeotdago jeonhaejinda.

paragraphs.jp: 오늘날 한국에서는 매년 시월 삼일을 개천절로 정하여 나라가 처음 세워진 날을 기념한다.
paragraphs.fr: Aujourd’hui, la Corée célèbre chaque 3 octobre la fête de Gaecheonjeol, jour de la fondation du pays.
paragraphs.en: Today, Korea celebrates 3 October each year as Gaecheonjeol, the day the nation was founded.
paragraphs.kana: 오늘날 한국에서는 매년 시월 삼일을 개천절로 정하여 나라가 처음 세워진 날을 기념한다.
paragraphs.roman: Oneullal hangugeseoneun maenyeon siwol samireul gaecheonjeollo jeonghayeo naraga cheoeum sewojin nareul ginyeomhanda.

paragraphs.jp: 「홍익인간」의 정신은 지금도 교육의 이념으로 이어지고 있다.
paragraphs.fr: L’idéal de « bénéficier largement à l’humanité » inspire encore aujourd’hui l’éducation.
paragraphs.en: The ideal of “benefiting all humankind” still underpins education today.
paragraphs.kana: 「홍익인간」의 정신은 지금도 교육의 이념으로 이어지고 있다.
paragraphs.roman: “Hongigingan”ui jeongsineun jigeumdo gyoyugui inyeomeuro ieojigo itda.

q.en: Why is it called “Gojoseon”?

choices.fr: Pour le distinguer du Joseon plus tardif
choices.en: To distinguish it from the later Joseon
Because it was in the south

q.en: What does 3 October commemorate?

title.fr: Boucle d’or et les trois ours

summary.fr: Une petite fille entre dans une maison vide au milieu de la forêt. Tout y va par trois…
summary.en: A little girl walks into an empty house in the middle of the forest. Everything there comes in threes…

paragraphs.jp: Once upon a time, there were three bears.
paragraphs.fr: Il était une fois trois ours.
paragraphs.en: Once upon a time, there were three bears.
paragraphs.kana: Once upon a time, there were three bears.

paragraphs.jp: There was a big father bear, a mother bear and a little baby bear.
paragraphs.fr: Il y avait un grand papa ours, une maman ours et un petit bébé ours.
paragraphs.en: There was a big father bear, a mother bear and a little baby bear.
paragraphs.kana: There was a big father bear, a mother bear and a little baby bear.

paragraphs.jp: They lived in a small house in the forest.
paragraphs.fr: Ils vivaient dans une petite maison dans la forêt.
paragraphs.en: They lived in a small house in the forest.
paragraphs.kana: They lived in a small house in the forest.

paragraphs.jp: One morning, the porridge was very hot.
paragraphs.fr: Un matin, le porridge était très chaud.
paragraphs.en: One morning, the porridge was very hot.
paragraphs.kana: One morning, the porridge was very hot.

paragraphs.jp: “Let’s go for a walk,” said Mother Bear.
paragraphs.fr: « Allons nous promener », dit maman ours.
paragraphs.en: “Let’s go for a walk,” said Mother Bear.
paragraphs.kana: “Let’s go for a walk,” said Mother Bear.

paragraphs.jp: The three bears went out, and the door was open.
paragraphs.fr: Les trois ours sortirent, et la porte resta ouverte.
paragraphs.en: The three bears went out, and the door was open.
paragraphs.kana: The three bears went out, and the door was open.

q.en: How many bears are there?
Why do the bears go out?

title.jp: Too hot, too cold, just right
title.en: Too hot, too cold, just right

paragraphs.jp: A little girl came to the house. Her name was Goldilocks.
paragraphs.fr: Une petite fille arriva à la maison. Elle s’appelait Boucle d’or.
paragraphs.en: A little girl came to the house. Her name was Goldilocks.
paragraphs.kana: A little girl came to the house. Her name was Goldilocks.

paragraphs.jp: She saw three bowls of porridge on the table.
paragraphs.fr: Elle vit trois bols de porridge sur la table.
paragraphs.en: She saw three bowls of porridge on the table.
paragraphs.kana: She saw three bowls of porridge on the table.

paragraphs.jp: The big bowl was too hot. The middle bowl was too cold.
paragraphs.fr: Le grand bol était trop chaud. Le bol moyen était trop froid.
paragraphs.en: The big bowl was too hot. The middle bowl was too cold.
paragraphs.kana: The big bowl was too hot. The middle bowl was too cold.

paragraphs.jp: The little bowl was just right, and she ate it all!
paragraphs.fr: Le petit bol était parfait, et elle le mangea en entier !
paragraphs.en: The little bowl was just right, and she ate it all!
paragraphs.kana: The little bowl was just right, and she ate it all!

paragraphs.jp: Then she saw three chairs.
paragraphs.fr: Puis elle vit trois chaises.
paragraphs.en: Then she saw three chairs.
paragraphs.kana: Then she saw three chairs.

paragraphs.jp: She sat on the little chair, but it broke!
paragraphs.fr: Elle s’assit sur la petite chaise, mais elle se cassa !
paragraphs.en: She sat on the little chair, but it broke!
paragraphs.kana: She sat on the little chair, but it broke!

paragraphs.jp: Goldilocks was tired, so she went upstairs.
paragraphs.fr: Boucle d’or était fatiguée, alors elle monta à l’étage.
paragraphs.en: Goldilocks was tired, so she went upstairs.
paragraphs.kana: Goldilocks was tired, so she went upstairs.

q.en: Which bowl does Goldilocks eat?

q.fr: Que se passe-t-il avec la petite chaise ?
q.en: What happens to the little chair?

paragraphs.jp: Upstairs, there were three beds.
paragraphs.fr: À l’étage, il y avait trois lits.
paragraphs.en: Upstairs, there were three beds.
paragraphs.kana: Upstairs, there were three beds.

paragraphs.jp: The little bed was just right, and Goldilocks fell asleep.
paragraphs.fr: Le petit lit était parfait, et Boucle d’or s’endormit.
paragraphs.en: The little bed was just right, and Goldilocks fell asleep.
paragraphs.kana: The little bed was just right, and Goldilocks fell asleep.

paragraphs.jp: Then the three bears came home.
paragraphs.fr: Puis les trois ours rentrèrent à la maison.
paragraphs.en: Then the three bears came home.
paragraphs.kana: Then the three bears came home.

paragraphs.jp: “Someone ate my porridge!” cried Baby Bear.
paragraphs.fr: « Quelqu’un a mangé mon porridge ! » cria bébé ours.
paragraphs.en: “Someone ate my porridge!” cried Baby Bear.
paragraphs.kana: “Someone ate my porridge!” cried Baby Bear.

paragraphs.jp: “And someone is sleeping in my bed!”
paragraphs.fr: « Et quelqu’un dort dans mon lit ! »
paragraphs.en: “And someone is sleeping in my bed!”
paragraphs.kana: “And someone is sleeping in my bed!”

paragraphs.jp: Goldilocks woke up, saw the bears and ran out of the house. She never came back!
paragraphs.fr: Boucle d’or se réveilla, vit les ours et s’enfuit de la maison. Elle ne revint jamais !
paragraphs.en: Goldilocks woke up, saw the bears and ran out of the house. She never came back!
paragraphs.kana: Goldilocks woke up, saw the bears and ran out of the house. She never came back!

q.en: Where does Goldilocks sleep?

q.fr: Que fait Boucle d’or quand elle voit les ours ?
q.en: What does Goldilocks do when she sees the bears?

summary.fr: Ses courtisans le disent plus puissant que la mer. Le roi Knut décide de leur donner une leçon sur la plage.

paragraphs.kana: His courtiers always told him how great he was. “You are the most powerful man in the world!” they said.

paragraphs.kana: Canute took his courtiers to the beach and sat on his throne near the water.

paragraphs.jp: “Waves, I order you to stop!” he shouted. But the waves kept coming.
